title: Excellent Tour, Excellent Guide
text: We have done several cycle tours in European cities and this one was probably the best one ever. Juan was a superb guide, he is extremely knowledgeable about Seville, he clearly loves the city and takes pride in his explanations and stories about this wonderful city. Very highly recommended.
author: Padraig_Q

title: Wonderful tour of Seville
text: Lovely cycle around the very flat Seville, at a very slow pace. 3 hours went by very quickly and our guide Sarii was amazing
author: Steve_L

title: A great way to discover the city

title: Great discovery by bike from Seville
text:
Nobody who rents bikes very attentive
The ALBA guide is really top. Several stops at the prestigious monuments, explained the history associated with it. Answer our questions. Keep the bikes if you want to get close to monuments or squares. I amply advise Alba as a guide who is always smiling and also very attentive

author: Penny_T

title: A great way to explore Sevillas highlights
text: I was so surprised to learn that bike tours were offered since I never saw them before and they are so convenient if the area is too big to walk in reasonable time. The guide Juan was just great and we had a wonderful time. His explanations were interesting and good to listen to. The tour gave us a good insight and backgrounds about the city highlights, especially around the exposition in 1921. Very recommendable
author: 250nuriai

title: Seville

title: Easy simple tour
